name: Ad Placements End-to-End (banner, purchase)
greenMarker: Ad placements verified by clicking them

mutations.name: an ad area is drawn while no advertiser is being served
mutations.why: A shipped build with VITE_ADS_PROVIDER=fake would show a grey box reading "테스트 | 광고 자리 (실제 광고 없음)" to every player and every reviewer. That reads as an unfinished app, which is a worse risk than any wording inside it.
mutations.expectFailure: an ad slot rendered with provider

note: The banner renders nothing while the placeholder provider is live, so this gate now checks the absence of an ad area rather than its wording. The mutation is the opposite of what it used to be: bringing the slot back is the defect.
